remarks:
There’s fully renovated, and then there’s this property. Completely gutted to the studs and meticulously rebuilt, this home is the result of an incredible amount of vision, craftsmanship and attention to detail. Not one thing was left untouched. Every system, finish and design element was thoughtfully selected with the goal of creating a home that is as beautiful as it is functional.

The stunning interior showcases all-new electrical throughout with new panel, plumbing, insulation, tankless water heater, central A/C, gas & water meters and sump pump, complemented by beautiful finishes including quartz countertops, soft-close cabinetry, LVT & tile flooring, tray ceilings, recessed lighting with dimmers, ceiling fans, custom built-ins and an electric fireplace. The kitchen is truly a showpiece with all-new Black Stainless Frigidaire appliances, double oven, gas cooktop and a dedicated coffee bar.

Beautiful French doors off the dining room open to the brand-new Trex back deck, creating a seamless connection to the outdoor living space. The fully finished basement adds 1,288 sq. ft. of additional living space with a second full bath featuring a walk-in shower, laundry room and spacious flex room perfect for a home gym, playroom, office or additional living space.

Outside, the attention to detail continues with brand-new landscaping, a custom-built pergola over the front porch, new garage door and widened driveway to accommodate two cars. The fully insulated garage features epoxy flooring. All plumbing and sewer lines have been professionally jetted and cleaned by KRD Plumbing, and the new electrical system was inspected by Fox Electric and the Village of Fredonia.

This is more than a renovation — it is a complete transformation. A home where every decision was intentional, every detail was considered, and every inch was given the attention it deserved. The result is truly something special. *OPEN HOUSE - SATURDAY (9/19) from 1-3PM*
